_note: Codex reports tokens, not dollars, so the worker and the scorecard price them from this table (usage.mjs codexPrice). USD per million tokens, Standard tier, as OpenAI lists them on `date` (the pricing page and each model's page in `sources`). `cached` is the cached-input rate and `write` the 30-minute cache-write rate; Codex's input_tokens already includes its cached and its written parts (cache_write_input_tokens). Every write is a 30-minute write: Codex sends no prompt_cache_options (OpenAI's default lifetime is 30 minutes) and reports writes as one count. A model with no `write` rate bills writes as input. `long` is the rate for every token of a request over `longContextAbove` input tokens, read per request from the run's rollout (its token_count events); a run past that threshold whose requests could not be read is of unknown cost (UNKNOWN_WHY `long-context`). A model matches by its exact id, after any provider prefix (`openai/`), as that id plus a dated snapshot suffix (`-2026-08-07`), or through `aliases` (an alias OpenAI documents as routing to one model); any other model is of unknown cost. `until` marks a promotional rate: it prices passes that end before that day (UTC), a later one is of unknown cost (`price-ended`), and doctor warns in the 7 days before it and fails from it.
